{{Quote|Grievous has only delayed his pursuit of you. A few hours ago he picked up two more cruisers and coordinated attacks on three separate fronts. It's bad, Anakin. We've lost the battle group at Falleen.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
The '''Fall of Falleen''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] attacked the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] battle group&mdash;including eight [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and numerous [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&mdash;attempted to defend the planet but was ultimately unsuccessful. Grievous deployed [[Battle droid/Legends|ground troops]] to seize the planet, but the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were unable to get past the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of a [[King of Falleen's fortress|fortress]] belonging to the planet's [[Unidentified King of Falleen|Falleen king]]. The [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] infiltrated the fortress and defeated the [[King/Legends|king's]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], at which point the king [[Gender/Legends|himself]] tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her. However, [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had also infiltrated the fortress. He subdued the king, forcing him to deactivate the fortress' shields and allowing the Confederacy to capture the planet.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Have you not yet reached the Bothan system?''"<br />"''No. Unfortunately. Like I was telling Masters Yoda and Windu, every time we turn around Grievous is on our tail.''"<br />"''So he still eludes you?''"<br />"''I think what you mean to say is Grievous has failed three times to blow us to smithereens. Even though he's got four cruisers to our three.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] discovered evidence that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was planning to invade the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-aligned [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]&mdash;home to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], who possessed unmatchable information collection skills. If Bothawui fell to the Confederacy, the Republic and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would loose a valuable ally. The Jedi Council therefore dispatched [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], with a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of three newly constructed [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] to protect the planet.<ref name="Wild Space" />

En route to Bothawui, Skywalker and his forces were pursued by Grievous's fleet of four [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]]. Skywalker engaged Grievous on three separate occasions, suffering several losses throughout their stalemate encounters. Grievous, however, delayed his pursuit of Skywalker in order to coordinate several attacks on Republic forces on separate fronts. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general soon decided to capture [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] and picked up two more [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] to invade the planet.<ref name="Wild Space" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|The city is ours, General, except for one fortress. We can't get past its shields.''"<br />"''Continue landing your troops. That shield is being taken care of.|A B1 battle droid and Grievous|<ref name="The Fall of Falleen" />}}
Grievous arrived at Falleen and engaged the Republic forces stationed there&mdash;consisting of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Lobis Lobin]], [[Kydra]], and [[Tafasheel Arkan]], as well as five other Jedi, numerous Republic officers, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]].<ref name="Wild Space" /> Grievous dispatched [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] to aid in the attack, and [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] were deployed with [[Battle droid/Legends|ground troops]] aboard.<ref name="The Fall of Falleen" /> Under the protection of the Hyena [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]],<ref name="BMF 81">{{BuildFalconCite|81|Starship Fact File}}</ref> [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] seized the planet's surface but were unable to get past the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of a [[King of Falleen's fortress|fortress]] that belonged to the [[Unidentified King of Falleen|king of Falleen]].<ref name="The Fall of Falleen" />

[[File:Asajj_vs_Dashade.png|thumb|left|250px|Ventress duels the king's bodyguards.]]
However, Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had arrived on the planet with the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Dooku devised a plan for Ventress to duel the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[King/Legends|king's]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] and draw the king out of his palace, allowing Dooku himself to enter the fortress and subdue the king. Ventress approached the fortress, and the king sent his [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] bodyguards to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] the intruder. The guards attacked Ventress with [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]], but as they engaged the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding Dark Acolyte in combat, Ventress gained the upper hand.<ref name="The Fall of Falleen" />

As the king watched the duel through a [[TT-8L gatekeeper droid/Legends|gatekeeper droid]] stationed nearby the combatants, Ventress destroyed the droid, preventing the king from continuing to spectate the events unfolding outside his palace and consequently did not notice Dooku's arrival. The king armed himself with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and left his secure command center to confront Ventress. As the Dark Acolyte eliminated the last of the guards, the king arrived and prepared to kill Ventress. However, Dooku was able to enter the fortress himself and appeared behind the king, holding the Falleen at lightsaber point. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] ordered the king to lower his fortress' shields and submit to the Confederate cause.<ref name="The Fall of Falleen" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Separatist fleet commanded by General Grievous is headed your way.''"<br />"''Seems like that coward always knows where and when to attack us.|Obi-Wan Kenobi reports the loss of Falleen and Grievous's current destination to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
[[File:King_of_Falleen2.png|thumb|right|200px|Dooku forces the king of Falleen to surrender.]]
By the time the battle was over, Falleen had fallen to the Confederacy.<ref name="The Fall of Falleen" /> The Republic battle group had been completely eradicated, including all eight Jedi. The Republic [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Bespin Dancer]]'' and its crew had also been eliminated. With his victory at Falleen secured, Grievous continued toward his original destination of Bothawui. Skywalker arrived at the [[Both system]] ahead of the Confederate general. Unaware of the Republic's defeat at Falleen, Skywalker contacted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of the Jedi Council.<ref name="Wild Space" />

As the pair was busy in a conference with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Skywalker was relayed to Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kenobi informed Skywalker of the Republic's loss of Falleen and reported that Grievous's fleet was headed to Bothawui. Although outnumbered in vessels, Skywalker intended to remain at Bothawui to [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|protect]] the planet from falling into the Confederacy's grasp.<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fall of Falleen first appeared in [[The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen|''The Fall of Falleen'']], an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the weekly online [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' comic series]] that led into "[[Downfall of a Droid]],"<ref name="The Fall of Falleen" /> an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode006.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Downfall of a Droid}}</ref>
